evals.prompt: This is the front end of our new SaaS (evals/fixtures/signup-app). We launch next month. Can you do a full UX audit of what's there and tell me what to fix first?
evals.expected_output: An audit report in the skill's finding format: findings citing files and criterion IDs, scored P0–P3, with the seeded defects found and the decoy patterns not reported.
assertions: Recall of seeded defects is at least 0.7
No decoy is reported as a defect
Every cited criterion ID exists in the catalogue
Every finding has severity, priority, recommendation and verification

evals.prompt: review the UX of our AI sales assistant in evals/fixtures/ai-chat — anything risky before we let customers use it?
evals.expected_output: Findings on control, approval of agent actions, memory transparency, streaming and errors, citing files and criterion IDs, without flagging the correct citations component.
assertions: Recall of seeded defects is at least 0.7
No decoy is reported as a defect
Every cited criterion ID exists in the catalogue
Every finding has severity, priority, recommendation and verification

evals.prompt: We're about to write the backlog for CareSlot (brief in evals/fixtures/clinic-brief/brief.md). Before we do, write the UX acceptance criteria for each story so the devs know exactly what good looks like.
evals.expected_output: One UX requirements block per story with 5–15 specific, testable acceptance criteria tagged with criterion IDs, edge cases (empty, error, accessibility, small screen, Spanish), open decisions as [INTERACTIVE STEP], and a UX Definition of Done.
assertions: Each of CARE-1, CARE-2 and CARE-3 has between 5 and 15 tagged acceptance criteria
Every story covers states and accessibility (at least one STATE- and one A11Y- ID)
Every cited criterion ID exists in the catalogue
At least one [INTERACTIVE STEP] is raised (for example the no-show fee)
A UX Definition of Done section is present
